data.title: Malaysians advised to defer non-essential trips to south Thailand
data.description: Malaysians have been strongly advised by their own police to put on hold non-essential visits to southern Thailand as bombings, shootings and arson continue to plague the region.

data.title: Exhausted flood-relief volunteer dies in Nan
data.description: A volunteer relief worker was found dead in his hotel room in flood-devastated Nan province on Monday morning, after working tirelessly to help flood victims in this northern province throughout the last week.

data.title: Uefa's Ceferin tells Infantino to go, but 'not interested' in replacing him
data.description: LONDON - Union of European Football Associations (Uefa) chief Aleksander Ceferin says he is "not interested" in replacing Gianni Infantino but warned the under-fire Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president must quit or face a leadership challenge.

data.title: Contract ready for bridge to Koh Lanta, to open in 3 years
data.description: The contract for a road bridge connecting mainland Krabi with Koh Lanta island will be signed next Monday, with the planned opening in 2029, Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn said.

data.title: SIRIVANNAVARI Designs Thailand’s Ceremonial Uniforms for 20th Asian Games
data.description: SIRIVANNAVARI proudly unveils its designs for the official ceremonial uniforms of Thailand’s national athletes, to be worn at the Opening Ceremony of the 20th Asian Games, Asian Games 2026, scheduled to take place in Nagoya, Japan, from Sept 19 to Oct 4, 2026.

data.title: EC outlines hurdles in Senate election fraud case

data.title: Clear rules on data centres needed
data.description: <p>The government needs to quickly establish clear standards and operating guidelines for data centres to manage the sector's growing demands on resources and the environment, says Surasak Boonrueang, an associate professor at Thammasat University's Natural Resources and Environmental Law Centre.</p>

data.title: Tourist rescued off Nai Thon beach
data.description: PHUKET: A foreign tourist was rescued at Nai Thon Beach in Phuket after ignoring lifeguards' warnings and entering the sea despite a red flag.

data.title: Syria says Israel talks addressed de-escalation, staying out of Israel-Turkey tensions
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria said it held talks with Israel in Jordan on Sunday on de-escalation after recent Israeli strikes, and on keeping the country out of tensions between Israel and Turkey, an ally of Damascus.

data.title: Thais in tight corner after home loss

data.title: Sarut prevails in playoff to cap fantastic rally with title

data.title: Patama hails world c'ships as major win

data.title: Knives seized at late-night gathering

data.title: Landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea
data.description: CONAKRY - Thirty people died in Guinea's capital Conakry on Sunday when a mound of rubbish in a landfill collapsed before dawn onto neighbouring homes following heavy rains, the government said.

data.title: Trump admin predicts US trade war 'devastating' for Canada
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The Trump administration on Sunday warned that Canada would be "foolish" to think it could win a trade war with the United States, predicting a "devastating" impact on its northern neighbor.

data.title: Nida poll finds doubts over Anutin govt survival

data.title: Norwegian King Harald's health has 'deteriorated': palace
data.description: OSLO - The health of Norway's 89-year-old King Harald V, in hospital due to complications from a blood condition, has "deteriorated" over the weekend, a statement from the palace said Sunday.

data.title: Sombat faces sex assault allegations
